page_results.notes: Architectural floor plan A01 for GROUND FLOOR with explicit 16.00 x 12.00 envelope and internal grid 7.00 + 2.00 + 7.00 by 4.00 + 4.00 + 4.00 (wall centreline datum). Room areas printed except G05 Hall; Hall area inferred from the dimensioned 2.00 m centre band running full 12.00 m height (2.00 x 12.00 = 24.00 m2). Split between G06 Stairs (16 m2) and G07 Foyer (12 m2) within the 7 x 4 right-bottom bay is not dimensioned; polygon not drawn for these two. Laundry vs WC partition inside the mid-left bay is not dimensioned; polygons not drawn; areas taken from labels. Door/window SIZES are not given; door_area and window_area therefore 0. Top-level wall_length and wall_area set to 0 because complete internal partition lengths and opening deductions are not fully dimensioned; external and main grid internal wall lengths are provided under page_evidence.quantities. Door count includes the yellow-line garage door (GD02). This is a preliminary AI takeoff—verify all quantities on the issued drawings.
